detail.longDescription: I have claude code mobile app on my android phone. I have connected my github account. I can ask claude to make changes and commit and push. That works. But if I ask claude to create and push tags I get a 403. Error: ERR push contains a ref outside refs/heads/*; only branch updates are permitted. How can I make claude push tags. I have tried looking att settings on my github page but can't find anything there.
